entry.title: Silent Payments coinbase
entry.summary:
SPc receivers require specialized scanners capable of extracting the `A_send` value directly from the coinbase scriptSig and applying the SPc derivation method. This approach differs from standard BIP352 handling, where such extraction is unnecessary, marking a clear compatibility boundary for wallets supporting these transactions.
To ensure robust processing and minimize future ambiguity, it is advisable to implement explicit encoding and versioning within the transaction data. Such measures allow forthcoming coinbase-tag formats to be clearly distinguished from current SPc data, preventing misinterpretation during wallet operations.
Additionally, precise specifications should be provided for wallet behavior when encountering same-height competing blocks during a blockchain reorganization. Clear guidelines in this regard help maintain consistency and correctness in transaction handling across varying network conditions.
